articles.title: Kids Across America Share What Freedom Means to Them on the Country's 250th Birthday
articles.summary: Imagine asking 700 kids what 'life, liberty, and the pursuit of happiness' means. That's what NPR did for America's 250th birthday. You'll hear about voting at 16, a grandpa's journey from Greece, and a secret escape route for slaves.

articles.title: Germany's Leader Fires Back After Trump Calls Their Military Spending 'Ridiculous'
articles.summary: President Trump says Germany spends too little on its military. But Germany's Chancellor Merz says they're actually doubling their defense budget and will hit NATO's target way ahead of schedule—by 2029!

articles.title: How a War Far Away Could Make Your Cereal More Expensive
articles.summary: The war in Iran has blocked a key waterway, causing a global fertilizer shortage. That means U.S. farmers are paying more to grow corn and wheat. But don't panic—experts say the price hike on your groceries will be small.
